verdict.rationale: Opting out of a vendor's own telemetry is a fair question for an observability SaaS with agents and SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to disable Datadog's own telemetry or usage tracking. The telemetry mentions (e.g., querying telemetry data) describe customer observability data, not a vendor opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
